answer: Interactive viva: after an identity posts an answer, a jury probes it live with unpredictable follow-up questions about the reasoning behind it, answered within minutes. A relic from a template bank handles prompts but folds under unscripted questions - the text was emitted, never understood. Attacker cost: a genuinely reasoning mind must be present per mask in real time, so cost scales linearly with identities instead of staying flat. A canyon of puppets fed by one brain serializes into a jade bottleneck, and the resulting latency pattern is itself detectable.
